environment.mode: Vite development server, Playwright, generated accounts

method.path: Production foreground ingestion entry point, real nostr-tools NIP-59 envelopes and browser worker/IndexedDB; excludes network relay latency
method.firstVisibleMs: First reactive chat preview observed by a 16 ms timer, not a paint measurement
method.timings: Single-run before/after samples; background activity and machine load vary. Diagnostic timings, not cross-client rankings.

changes: Index reply references instead of reading the conversation for every received DM.
Seek the newest incoming message by author for read cursors; skip entire outgoing histories.
Read only messages after the seen boundary during unread reconciliation.
Page reaction-bearing rows through an index, including legacy reactions without event IDs.
Validate chat existence, deduplicate and insert each message in a single atomic transaction.
Resolve exact events and edit references in one transaction; avoid duplicate ingestion lookups.
Batch up to 64 encrypted inbox writes per transaction; resolve each enqueue only after commit.
Prioritize live subscriptions and preempt a historical page when new foreground traffic arrives.
Use indexed author lookups for notification eligibility and timestamp windows for edit replacement.
safety: Signature verification, sender binding and worker decryption are unchanged.
Private-key storage policy is unchanged; benchmarks use disposable generated accounts and report no keys or contents.
UI staging precedes message persistence; ordered commits and the eight-message uncommitted bound remain.
Acknowledgements remain tied to durable commits; failed message writes keep the encrypted retry record.
Additive v5 indexes are tested against existing v2/v3 data; v3 message rows remain identical after migration.
Concurrent duplicates, aborted inserts, aborted inbox batches, retry and foreground preemption have regression tests.
limits: No competing clients, external signers, mobile devices or production relay networks were benchmarked.
First-preview latency and worst heartbeat did not show a reliable improvement in the synthetic burst; no claim is made for those metrics.
One-time index construction can delay the first opening of an established database.
Text search, explicit chat acceptance and deletion may still traverse history; this audit concentrates on normal DM ingestion and read-state reconciliation.
Reply repair reads matching replies, and reaction reconciliation reads matching reaction rows; work grows with those matches, not unrelated messages.

validation.production_build: Web build and Tauri release binary passed (--no-bundle); installers not built

amethyst_followups_notes: Persistent account-scoped completion receipts skip worker decryption across reloads.
Ciphertext journaling overlaps processing; message and chat summary commit in one transaction before receipt acknowledgement.
Relay history uses bounded per-relay pages, overlapping boundary timestamps and real EOSE.
First-unread and latest-incoming lookups seek by author; no scan of outgoing history.
Single development-mode sample. Not an Amethyst comparison or a fastest-client claim. First-visible timing observes reactive state, not paint.
Full-suite sample: 17.17 s vs isolated 12.78 s, with ~1316-1318 transactions in both. Repeat timings vary; no throughput improvement is established over the previous round.

amethyst_followups_validation.live_iroh: Two generated accounts: audio, video, screen sharing, group rooms
amethyst_followups_validation.production_build: passed; Vite reports a bundle exceeding its 500 kB advisory threshold
amethyst_followups_validation.native_packaging: not rerun; no native source changes
amethyst_followups_validation.visual_review: Compared original and rebuilt login and seeded desktop/mobile chat screens; no exhaustive pixel-difference certification
